column1: # Lemmas that src/ambiguitychecker.py should drop from a stroke cluster's words
# before classifying it as lemma-homophone-ambiguous. Reviewed by hand against the
# roadmap work -- see ROADMAP.md, unrelated to the separate reform1990 thread). Each
# entry is a word too rare, archaic, foreign, or otherwise unlikely to ever compete
# for its own steno discriminator symbol -- dropping it shrinks or removes the
# cluster it was inflating, without touching the actual lexicon/theory (the word
# stays typable; this file only affects the ambiguity *metric*).
#   lemme   -- the Word.lemme string this entry matches (exact, case-sensitive).
#              Where a lemme string is shared by two unrelated senses (rare, but
#              see reform1990.tsv's own comma-joined-lemme problem), this list
#              can't distinguish them -- none of the current entries hit that case.
#                anglicism_loan     -- borrowed from another language (not always
#                unpopular_spelling -- a real, still-used word, but this spelling
#                                      of it is markedly less common than another
#                sociolect          -- live modern slang/sociolectal register, not
#                data_artifact      -- suspected Lexique383 tagging error rather
#                                      than a genuine distinct word (e.g. a common
#                                      verb conjugation mistagged as a rare noun,
#                                      -- kept distinct from the other reasons since
#                                      it flags a potential upstream data bug, not
#                                      a word to simply deprioritize; see todo.md
